details.label: Discussion
details.text: An MCS has organized along the NM/TX/OK border over the past hour, with some severe gusts noted, including a measured 73 kt gust from the KCAO ASOS. This MCS continues to propagate east-southeastward amid a dry and well-mixed boundary layer, with well over 1500 J/kg MUCAPE noted. Given the degree of evaporative cooling potential and convective organization in place, a severe wind swath may accompany this MCS as it progresses across the TX Panhandle. It is unclear how the severe wind threat will be impacted by the westward drifting outflow boundary from another cluster of storms. Nonetheless, in the near-term, severe gusts should continue to accompany the MCS, some of which may exceed 75 mph
